research.title: Hughes & Shelton 1958, The Mechanism of Gill Ventilation in Three Freshwater Teleosts
research.scope: Primary measurements in three freshwater species, not these six source specimens
research.finding: Buccal and opercular movements coordinated with a phase lag; do not force synchronous mouth and gill oscillation

research.title: 2013 Hydrodynamic resistance and flow patterns in the gills of a tilapine fish
research.scope: Primary tilapia isolated gill-flow experiment; generic double-pump principle, not specimen animation calibration
research.finding: Oral/opercular valves with coupled pressure chambers give largely one-way pulsatile ventilation

research.title: Wegner et al. 2013 Structural adaptations for ram ventilation: gill fusions in scombrids and billfishes
research.scope: Primary 28 scombrid and 7 billfish species anatomical study
research.finding: Ram ventilators including tunas adapted to fast continuous ventilatory flow; a swimming tuna mouth policy should retain small gape rather than force recurrent complete closure

research.title: 2019 Ontogenetic changes in cutaneous and branchial ionocytes and morphology in yellowfin tuna larvae
research.scope: Larval development study; cannot apply larval rates or dimensions to adult model
research.finding: Yellowfin morphology develops ram-ventilation supporting gill fusions; exact source-label identity and size unknown
